- [nvstat - Linux NVIDIA GPU State & BIOS Telemetry CLI](/data/crypto/nvstat/DESC.md): Lightweight high-performance Linux CLI utility querying NVIDIA driver ioctls, NVML, and PCIe VBIOS subsystem descriptors to report real-time GPU power, thermals, clocks, and exact vendor hardware names.

- [F-16 Full Mission Flight Training Device (FTD)](/data/T&E/F16-FTD/DESC.md): High-fidelity supersonic fighter simulator replicating flight handling qualities, tactical cockpit avionics, and mission systems.

- [ObjectBrowser - Unity Reflection & Type Inspector](/data/unity/object-browser/DESC.md): Deep runtime and editor reflection inspector for Unity3D, exposing all properties, fields, methods, and complete base class inheritance hierarchies for any selected scene GameObject or project asset.

- [BO-105 Light Twin Helicopter Simulator](/data/T&E/BO/DESC.md): Full flight simulator refurbishment and internal R&D testbed featuring motor control loading, tablet glass cockpit instrumentation, curved visual warping, and a VR-immersed motion platform.

- [ACV-300 Armored Combat Vehicle Simulator](/data/T&E/acv/DESC.md): Tracked armored combat vehicle simulator designed for crew coordination, combat driving, turret operation, and tactical engagement.
- [libDIS - IEEE 1278 Protocol Engine](/data/T&E/libDIS/DESC.md): In-house C++ library implementing the IEEE 1278 Distributed Interactive Simulation (DIS) protocol for low-latency networked simulation.
- [Project G1 - 3D Anti-Gravity Tunnel Racing Engine](/data/G1/DESC.md): State-of-the-art anti-gravity space tunnel racing prototype engine written from scratch in C++ and DirectX 9 with custom HLSL shaders and procedural spline geometry.
